mapper.select: SELECT A.data_id, A.subject, A.url, A.category_team, crypto_dec('normal', A.user_name, '', 0) user_name, A.password, A.email, A.content, A.hits, A.board_code, A.sub_category, A.created_date, A.target_option, A.rel_option, A.notice_flag, A.visible_type, A.seller_select_flag, A.use_yn FROM ( SELECT data_id, subject, url, category_team, user_name, password, email, content, hits, board_code, sub_category, created_date, target_option, rel_option, notice_flag, visible_type, seller_select_flag, use_yn FROM op_community_databoard WHERE data_id = #{value} )A
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO op_community_databoard (DATA_ID, SUBJECT, URL, CATEGORY_TEAM, USER_NAME, PASSWORD, EMAIL, CONTENT, HITS, BOARD_CODE, SUB_CATEGORY, CREATED_DATE, TARGET_OPTION, REL_OPTION, NOTICE_FLAG, VISIBLE_TYPE, SELLER_SELECT_FLAG, USE_YN) VALUES (#{dataId}, #{subject}, #{url}, #{categoryTeam}, crypto_enc('normal', #{userName},''), #{password}, #{email}, #{content}, #{hits}, #{boardCode}, #{subCategory}, , #{targetOption}, #{relOption}, #{noticeFlag}, #{visibleType}, #{sellerSelectFlag}, #{useYn})
mapper.update: UPDATE op_community_databoard SET SUBJECT = #{subject}, URL = #{url}, USER_NAME = crypto_enc('normal', #{userName},''), CONTENT = #{content}, TARGET_OPTION = #{targetOption}, REL_OPTION = #{relOption}, NOTICE_FLAG = #{noticeFlag}, VISIBLE_TYPE = #{visibleType}, SELLER_SELECT_FLAG = #{sellerSelectFlag}, USE_YN=#{useYn} WHERE DATA_ID = #{dataId}

sql.where:
AND USE_YN = 'Y'

mapper.select:
SELECT A.data_id, A.subject, A.url, A.url_type , A.category_team, A.target_option, A.rel_option, A.sub_category, A.notice_flag,
crypto_dec('normal', A.user_name, '', 0) user_name, A.password, A.email, A.content, A.hits, A.board_code,
A.created_date, A.file_ty FROM ( SELECT D.data_id, D.subject, CASE WHEN url IS NULL OR url = '' THEN CONCAT('/data-board/detail?dataId=',D.data_id) ELSE TRIM(D.url) END AS url , CASE WHEN D.url IS NULL OR D.url = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS url_type , D.category_team, D.target_option, D.rel_option, D.sub_category, D.notice_flag,
D.user_name, D.password, D.email, D.content, D.hits, D.board_code,
D.created_date, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(file_ty) FROM op_data_board_file WHERE data_id = D.data_id) AS file_ty FROM op_community_databoard D
ORDER BY IFNULL(D.notice_flag, 'N') DESC , CASE WHEN IFNULL(D.notice_flag, 'N') = 'Y' THEN D.data_id ELSE 0 END DESC
, D.created_date , D.hits , D.created_date
ASC DESC
, D.created_date DESC
) A
